title: Avoid context observer reservations for undeclared Engram projects
outcome: Ordinary prompt dispatch in a project without an Engram declaration does not create an advisory context observer that can only return NotApplicable.
acceptance: The scheduler uses the current local declaration cache to skip reservation and observer creation for undeclared projects, while a later marker addition still enables context preparation through the existing off-lock declaration refresh.
A deterministic test proves repeated sends or queue drains without a marker create no context observer and retain correct prompt delivery.
